name: Monday RTH long (09:30 -> 15:55)
why: No one can hedge over the weekend, so funds and dealers cut exposure into Friday's close and carry less risk through it; on Monday they put it back on during the cash session (2026-10-17 behaviour map: Monday RTH +12 bp vs +3.6 bp an average session, up in 13 of 17 years). Pre-registered from that map; holdout 2025-01 on is judged once.
